paragraphs: Direct judgment: if you are willing to handle product selection, listing, pricing, customer service, shipping, and reconciliation at the same time, and can judge whether the business truly makes money from gross margin and refunds, you can explore online retail merchant work.
Good signals: willing to verify inventory, logistics, taxes, and customer promises against actual orders; notifies and remedies first when stockouts or delays occur.
Safe trial: use a fully fictional set of three products, purchase prices, platform fees, shipping, and return scenarios to build a one-week shop ledger, without real collection or shipping.
Review: check whether profit remains after subtracting purchase, platform fees, payment fees, shipping, returns, and advertising from revenue; distinguish sales scale from disposable income.
O*NET 13-1199.06 Online Merchants refers to retail businesses operating exclusively online and may involve business strategy, purchasing, inventory, marketing, fulfillment, and finance.
The core deliverable is reviewable product information, orders, shipping, and income and expenditure, not just writing pages or running ads.
Work may be done on a proprietary website, a platform store, or in a distribution process; the responsible person must coordinate suppliers, warehousing, payment, logistics, and customer service.
Tools include shop backends, order and inventory systems, electronic payment, customer service messages, product images, and spreadsheets.
Unlike marketing managers, online merchants directly take on products, inventory, and order fulfillment; unlike purchasing managers, they also handle sales and after-sales.
Quality means accurate product descriptions, available inventory, matching payments and orders, timely shipping, return handling, and accounts matching reality.
Operating e-commerce in China also requires verifying platform terms and consumer, tax, and data rules in the locality; a U.S. O*NET title does not automatically map to a Chinese statutory identity.
Adjacent directions: marketing managers, advertising and promotions managers, wholesale and retail buyers, market research analysts, order clerks, and customer service representatives.
Marketing managers handle broader branding, budgets, and teams; online merchants must sell and deliver specific products and take on inventory and after-sales.
Buyers focus on supply, cost, and contracts; online merchants also handle listing, pricing, sales, and customer communication.
Retail salespersons sell face to face in stores, while online merchants handle online product selection, fulfillment, and the complete operating profit and loss.
If you like serving customers directly without taking on the whole shop operation, retail salesperson may be the choice.
Listing
Verify product facts, prices, and images and text.
Customer service
Verify orders, refunds, and consumer rights.
Inventory
Cross-check the warehouse, delivery dates, and overselling risk.
Operators
Reconcile profit, data permissions, and tax responsibility.

Evidence insufficient: the national same-measure occupational wage and operating net income for Chinese online merchants are still not obtained. The 2025 pre-tax annual average for wholesale and retail trade is 135,749 yuan for urban non-private units and 69,622 yuan for private units, serving only as broad industry background for the retail employment direction, including other wholesale and retail posts, and not the online merchant wage, profit, or a personal range; self-employed individuals and freelancers are excluded, and shop owners must be verified separately.
Operator sales, shop profit, dividends, and employee wages are different metrics; platform GMV cannot replace personal income.
Evidence insufficient: there is no same-scope Chinese job wage percentile or merchant net profit distribution; retail industry averages cannot be substituted.
Local platform rules, tax, consumer, advertising, and personal information obligations are verified against the operating entity and locality.
Evidence insufficient: O*NET 13-1199.06 does not publish a separate Online Merchants wage median; the page shows the parent category 13-1199 other business operations specialists proxy.
The BLS parent category 13-1199 2025 median annual wage of 83,050 USD is not the online retail merchant wage or shop owner profit.
The parent category's wage percentiles and education distribution cover multiple business operations posts and cannot explain online retail merchant starting pay.
The BLS parent category had about 1,157,600 people in 2025, which is not the online retail merchant specific employment.

BLS parent category 13-1199 is projected to grow 3.9% overall over 2025—2035, with an official net increase of 44,700 and average annual 98,700 openings including replacement; this is not specific to 13-1199.06, is not allocated to online merchants, and is not AI adoption or replacement or personal unemployment probability.
U.S. wage proxies do not represent Chinese employees, individual merchants, or owner-operator income; sales cannot be equated with wages either.

paragraphs: Strong match evidence is being able to explain gross margin, stockouts, refunds, and customer handover in a fictional shop ledger, not claiming to like e-commerce.
The one-week paper trial should produce a product page, inventory table, order process, customer service replies, and a simple income statement.
Untrue product descriptions: fabricated specifications or images may mislead customers; check against the physical item and the supplier's original text before going live.
Inventory mismatch: overselling leads to cancellations and complaints; synchronize sellable quantity with the supply cycle.
Payment and refunds: unreconciled amounts, taxes, or returns erode profit; verify records order by order.
Customer information disclosure: addresses and payment details are sensitive; handle per platform and local permissions.
Shared escalation: on stockouts, quality complaints, lost shipments, or platform abnormalities, pause the promise first, notify the customer, and preserve evidence.
First experience the business with fictional products and orders; do not collect real payments or touch customer information.
At entry, first verify products, supply, platform terms, and consumer promises.
The portfolio should include accurate product pages, a purchasing and gross margin table, and inventory and return processes.
Job seeking or starting a business must distinguish employee posts from the operating entity.
The one-week trial runs from product selection and listing to simulated orders and refunds.
Platform certification does not equal tax, operating, and consumer obligations.
Ability expands from single-product order handling to multi-product inventory and profit and loss.
Moving to marketing, purchasing, or operations management requires adding the target role's knowledge.
Operating trials use fictional data only; actual operations must verify registration, platform rules, payment, tax, and consumer obligations.

BLS parent category 13-1199 had 1,157,600 employed in 2025, overall growth of 3.9% over 2025—2035, a net increase of 44,700, and average annual 98,700 openings including replacement; this is not specific to online merchants, AI adoption or replacement, or personal unemployment, and the detailed category is not allocated in proportion to headcount.
Platform merchant counts, shop GMV, and available employee posts are not the same metric; recruitment samples must be verified by region and time.
Automation may change copywriting, customer service, and inventory tasks, but there is no AI replacement rate for this detailed category.
You can move to marketing, purchasing, orders, customer service, or platform operations; compare the final profit and loss and the authorization scope.

components.definition_block: Online retail merchants are responsible for the products, orders, customers, and income and expenditure of an exclusively online sales business; this is not the same as doing advertising only or simple order entry.

fermat_decision_card.summary: If you are willing to handle product selection, closing sales, fulfillment, customer service, and reconciliation at the same time, and can look at net profit rather than only GMV, you can do a one-week trial with fictional products.
fermat_decision_card.title: Online retail merchants

hero.quick_answer: Online retail merchants are responsible for product selection and purchasing, product listing, pricing and marketing, inventory, order fulfillment, customer communication, and income and expenditure reconciliation for exclusively online sales; sales revenue is not personal wages, and platform growth does not equal profit.
